membership.softness_policy: preregistered from development stability and hard-limit sensitivity; experimental hydration values forbidden
membership.surface_smoothing_policy: tau>0 is preregistered from force-continuity and tau->0 measure-sensitivity tests; experimental hydration values forbidden
membership.periodic_image_adapter: symmetric lattice-image shells with relative log-weight tolerance 50; more than four shells fails closed
membership.effective_volume_tail_bound: softmin(d_i)>=min(d_i)-tau*ln(Ncenter); finite integration boxes and omitted-tail bounds expand every atom sphere by tau*ln(Ncenter)

soft_occupancy.algorithm: production O(Nwater*nmax) active-support recurrence plus aggregate tail; exhaustive O(Nwater^2) recurrence retained for finite oracle tests
soft_occupancy.production_support: preregistered active occupancies n=0..nmax plus one aggregate overflow tail bin n>nmax
soft_occupancy.simplex_reconstruction: one preregistered well-conditioned bin; never the numerical far-tail by implicit position
soft_occupancy.tail_mass_gate: tail probability must be below the protocol tail_mass_upper_bound

same_measure_bindings: boundary-independent membership_surface_hash plus explicit periodic/nonperiodic adapter bridge

solute_flexibility.fixed_conformer_diagnostic: one coordinate-hash-bound conformer; approximate and diagnostic only
solute_flexibility.registered_conformer_ensemble: preregistered conformers and weights; averaging occurs outside the packing estimator
